findings.quote: handled every detail according to their judgment
findings.problem: Greek: κατὰ τὴν ἐκείνων γνώμην, where ἐκείνων = the consuls (τῶν ὑπάτων), not Gnaeus and his officers (contrast earlier κατὰ τὴν ἑαυτῶν γνώμην). English 'their' reads as the officers' own judgment, inverting the sense.
findings.proposed_fix: handled every detail according to the consuls' judgment
